items.title: Fever held to 35pts in the 1H, trailed by 3 entering 4Q — then outscored the Wings 35-21. A 98-87 win, their 3rd in a row. Now 8-2 over the last month.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Fever held to 35pts in the 1H, trailed by 3 entering 4Q — then outscored the Wings 35-21. A 98-87 win, their 3rd in a row. Now 8-2 over the last month.

Clark had 29/10a, Mitchell scored 23, extending streak to 18 straight games w/ 20+. Ty Harris 5/5 from 3.

Next: Sun. at ATL

items.title: Wasn't sure how this game was gonna go with the Wings shorthanded, but it's been a good one.
items.author: Alexa Philippou
items.body_excerpt:
Wasn't sure how this game was gonna go with the Wings shorthanded, but it's been a good one.
 
Fun duel between Caitlin Clark (26 pts, 6 assists, 3 rebounds) and Paige Bueckers (25 pts, 6 rebounds, 3 assists)

Wings lead 66-63 heading into the 4th

items.title: Caitlin Clark with 17 of her 26pts in the 3Q, more than all but Bueckers have for the game.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Caitlin Clark with 17 of her 26pts in the 3Q, more than all but Bueckers have for the game.

Not bad for the 11th best guard in the WNBA.

Wings led after 2 and against after 3, 66-63.

items.title: This is a good test for the Fever, a game where 3s aren't falling. Just 3/13.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
This is a good test for the Fever, a game where 3s aren't falling. Just 3/13.

And each time they score, the Wings, and especially Bueckers, seem to have an answer.

Clark has had the hot hand, scoring so well off the dribble.
